href.description: (OPTIONAL) If provided, the image will be wrapped in a link pointing to this URL

circular.description: Whether to make the image circular

hideCaption.description: Whether to visually hide the caption while keeping it accessible to screen readers

objectFit.description: How the image should be resized to fit its container

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the image container (CSS value like '300px' or '50%')

maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the image container (CSS value like '200px' or '50%')
